Pacific Douglas, October 2026. Detached houses: 35 listed at month end and 8 sold in October, a sales ratio of 23% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 27 listed at month end and 0 sold in October.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 21 sold over 5 months against an average of 35.2 listed, about 8.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was October with 8 sold. Condos and townhomes: 11 sold over 5 months against an average of 22.4 listed, about 10.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 6 sold.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Pacific Douglas (Douglas), South Surrey

Tucked between the Peace Arch and Pacific Highway crossings, Douglas is border living and Surrey’s southernmost urban neighbourhood. The usual trade-off is quick crossing access against how quiet the interior streets are.
The 8 closest neighbourhoods we cover, nearest first. Distances are straight-line between centre points, so the drive is longer.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Pacific Douglas?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 35 houses listed with 8 sold in the month and 27 condos and townhomes listed with 0 sold in the month in Pacific Douglas. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Pacific Douglas a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 23%, a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
